title: Ready for the potty?
intro: Most children show signs of potty readiness between 18 and 36 months. Every child is different, and there is no right answer. Use this page to note what you see.
youngNote: {name} is {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} old. That is early, but feel free to note any signs you see along the way.

signals.title: What have you noticed?
signals.hint: Tap the signs you have seen.
signals.DRY_TWO_HOURS: Stays dry for two hours or more
signals.DISCOMFORT_DIRTY_DIAPER: Dislikes a wet or dirty diaper
signals.INTEREST_IN_TOILET: Shows interest in the toilet or potty
signals.PULLS_PANTS_UP_DOWN: Pulls pants up and down alone

logSelected: {count, plural, one {Log # sign now} other {Log # signs now}}

level.none: No signs noted yet. That is perfectly fine. Watch what your child shows interest in.
level.few: You have started to see signs. Keep observing and let your child set the pace.
level.some: Several signs are showing up. Your child may be ready soon, but there is no rush.
level.many: You see many signs. This could be a good time to try the potty.
